steps.en: Officer opens a page to set stages where payment is allowed
steps.id: Officer membuka halaman untuk mengatur stage yang boleh dibayar
steps.why_en: No such settings page exists; the stages are written into the program.
steps.why_id: Halaman pengaturan itu tidak ada; stage ditulis di dalam program.

steps.en: The system decides at which stages payment is allowed
steps.id: Sistem menentukan di stage mana pembayaran diizinkan
steps.why_en: Several separate rules decide this, all fixed in the program and not fully consistent.
steps.why_id: Beberapa aturan terpisah menentukannya, semua tetap di program dan tidak sepenuhnya seragam.

steps.en: The public portal lets people pay only when allowed
steps.id: Portal publik hanya mengizinkan pembayaran bila diizinkan
steps.why_en: It follows the allowed flag, but court-stage notices in an open ticket cannot be paid.
steps.why_id: Portal mengikuti tanda boleh bayar, tetapi notice stage court di tiket terbuka tidak bisa dibayar.

steps.en: Officer sets the payment grace period in days
steps.id: Officer mengatur payment grace period dalam hari
steps.why_en: Only a payment due days value per stage exists; it feeds letters and notices, not payment acceptance.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada nilai hari batas bayar per stage; dipakai di surat dan notifikasi, bukan penerimaan pembayaran.

steps.en: The grace period can differ for each notice type
steps.id: Grace period bisa berbeda untuk tiap notice type
steps.why_en: One value per stage applies to all notice types.
steps.why_id: Satu nilai per stage berlaku untuk semua notice type.

steps.en: Payment is closed automatically after the payment deadline passes
steps.id: Pembayaran ditutup otomatis setelah batas waktu bayar lewat
steps.why_en: Only court cases are covered, and the job runs only when started by hand.
steps.why_id: Hanya kasus pengadilan yang tercakup, dan job hanya jalan jika dijalankan manual.
